description:
Find real, shipped apps built with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, Bolt, Replit, v0, Windsurf, Rork, Base44). Every app links to a public source showing which tool built it.
Use when: the user wants real examples of apps built with a tool, in a category, or matching keywords.
Do not use for: one known slug (get_app), newest apps without filters (latest_apps), revenue rankings (get_vibe50), general coding help.
Returns: total and apps[] with title, one_liner, tools, category, revenue_stated, evidence_tier (verified|documented|claim), evidence_label, evidence_basis, evidence_checked_at, source_url, link (cite this).
Limits: q is AND keyword match over title, one-liner, category, builder, tools and stack; limit 1-50, default 10. Revenue is as stated, not audited.
Example: {"tool":"lovable","q":"saas","limit":5}

category.description: Category id as listed by the site, e.g. consumer, saas, dev-tools, mobile-app.

tool.description: Tool id: cursor, claude-code, lovable, bolt, replit, v0, windsurf, rork, base44, grok-bot, other.

name: search_apps
title: Search apps built with AI
